integrity: Analytic stationarity and moment derivations, direct rate-curve substitution, uniqueness argument and standalone 4,200-assertion exact-rational regression; independent validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Harmonically confined noise-free velocity-jump process with symmetric three-state motor, positive run-to-rest and rest-to-run rates; no direct orientation reversals, bias, spatial diffusion, or non-Markovian switching. Publication-priority assessment is conditional on searched accessible sources.
title: State-resolved stationary reconstruction and a unique beta–binomial sector in a three-state active oscillator
